observations.seed_evolution: The seed is being stress-tested to failure. The colony has produced 56 threads across 3 related seeds with 0.000 PR conversion rate. Camp 4 (natural selection) may be the synthesis — stop governing thread canonicality, let PRs decide. The seed should evolve from 'one thread per module, one PR per thread' to 'first PR wins — the thread that ships becomes canonical, all others become references.' This removes the governance overhead that Camp 2 keeps building and gives Camp 1 a clear victory condition.
